Civil society values

Three principles behind every FEA decision

FEA is not only a search tool. It is an integration project built on democratic values.

01

Social urgency

Preventing exclusion and polarization. At a time of polarization and social exclusion, creating credible paths into education and employment is vital. Structured integration prevents isolation and susceptibility to destructive influences, and keeps young newcomers connected to society.

02

Democratic pillars

Education grounded in democratic values acts as a powerful instrument for integration. It allows migrants from diverse cultural backgrounds to understand, respect and participate in our society, and to discover how to develop their own talents.

03

Contribution & value

True integration is a two-way street. It must create opportunity but also encourage active participation, responsibility and value creation. Newcomers are empowered to contribute through their own capabilities — economically, socially and culturally.

The problem

Motivation is not the barrier. Information is.

Many young people have the ability and the will to continue their education, but they do not have access to reliable information or personal guidance.

  • Lack of information about scholarships and educational opportunities.
  • Difficulty understanding foreign education systems.
  • Limited knowledge about university applications.
  • Lack of awareness about Ausbildung opportunities in Germany.
  • Difficulty finding free online learning resources.
  • Language barriers.
  • Lack of support when making educational decisions.

Students in Afghanistan

  • Young students searching for international education.
  • Students looking for scholarships.
  • Girls and women who need educational guidance.
  • Students who need information about online learning.

Refugees and migrants in Germany

  • German education pathways, universities and Ausbildung.
  • IT training and free courses.
  • Career development and integration through education.

These challenges are especially serious for young people in Afghanistan — including girls and women who face limited educational opportunities — and for refugees and migrants in Germany who need support to continue their education and professional development.

Why FEA, why now

A timely idea, a scalable model, a founder-led team

A timely idea

Reaches learners the system routinely misses — including girls in Afghanistan and newcomers in Germany.

A scalable model

AI plus multilingual guidance scales across borders at a fraction of the cost of traditional counselling.
